description: List the organization's notification channels, to get the ids that channel_ids of monitors and heartbeats take: every member's own email channel, then added email addresses, then the other channels. Each has id, type, label, is_verified, is_active, state, member_name (the member whose own email channel it is, else null) and destination_hint (a masked email address, a chat id, or a webhook's scheme and host). state is WORKING, MUTED, PENDING_CONFIRMATION, BROKEN or PLAN_DISABLED (off because of the plan: it receives nothing until it is enabled again in the dashboard); only a WORKING channel receives alerts. An active channel can be bound in any state; a muted (inactive) or unknown id cannot be newly bound (404). Alerts go only to channels: if none works, the organization's owner is emailed. Channels are added and changed only in the dashboard. Returns a page: items plus total, page, size and pages; ask for the next page until you have seen total rows. An invalid value is a 422 naming the argument. Example: {"state": ["WORKING"], "size": 100}

ids.description: Keep these channels: a JSON array of 1 to 100 channel uuids, for example the channel_ids of a monitor that has some; never []. Unknown ids are left out. Not together with q (a 422).

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the label, the member's name or destination_hint, up to 255 characters; a webhook is found by its label only. Not together with ids (a 422).

size.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100; default 25. Keep paging until you have seen total rows.

state.description: Keep channels in any of these states: a JSON array.

type.description: Keep channels of any of these types: a JSON array.

name: list_channels

state.description: Known values: WORKING, MUTED, PENDING_CONFIRMATION, BROKEN, PLAN_DISABLED.

type.description: Known values: EMAIL, TELEGRAM, WEBHOOK, SLACK, DISCORD.

title: List notification channels
